edition_policy: Only current and fixed legacy remain visible. No intermediate profile or new old-spelling aliases.

rationale.ŝtip: User adopted 木块: preserve large wooden block, log, firewood and figurative meanings without a round-shape restriction; retain existing root decomposition.
rationale.pensi: User adopted 年金: identify the periodic pension payment directly; distinguish pens (think) and pension (lodging), retaining current root decomposition.
rationale.sankci: User adopted 裁ˢ: 裁 covers ruling/approval and penalty without restricting the root to 制裁; retain annotations of both senses and existing 裁 group ownership.
